title: Bookmark editor
font: Label heading and actions: system sans, 14sp Medium (500); caption field: 16sp Regular (400).

font: Channel labels: system sans, 14sp Medium (500); values: 14sp Regular (400).

title: Direct reference entry
font: Prompt: system sans, 16sp Regular (400), with inline bold emphasis; suggestions: 16sp Medium (500).

title: Version metadata dialog
font: Metadata label: bold (700), 0.7× the dialog body size; existing dialog body typography is retained.
note: Metadata labels no longer convert to uppercase. Version names and technical identifiers retain their casing.

title: Native sign-in
font: Action labels: system sans, 14sp Medium (500); fields: 16sp Regular (400).
note: Native action buttons preserve sentence case through the shared platform and AppCompat styles.

title: Developer sync controls
font: Actions: system sans, 14sp Medium (500); explanatory text: 14sp Regular (400).
note: Action labels and section names no longer force capitals. Diagnostic codes retain their supplied casing. No action is invoked in this capture.

title: Song search
font: Search field: 16sp Regular (400); filter labels: 14sp Medium (500).
note: The All/Semua songbook label is sentence case.

title: Song text component fixture
font: Tune: sans serif, 17.5dp Regular (400); copyright: 15dp Bold (700); body: serif, 20dp Regular (400).
note: Production song renderer with fixed mixed-case source text. Tune names and copyright retain source casing. This is a component fixture, not a downloaded song.

font: Book: 16sp Medium (500); entered values: 24sp Medium (500); digits: 28sp Medium (500); confirmation: 14sp Medium (500).

title: Native Bible keypad
font: Book: 16sp Medium (500); values: 24sp Medium (500); digits: 28sp Medium (500); confirmation: 14sp Medium (500).
note: Native keypad confirmation follows the same sentence-case rule.

title: Song keypad, selected Option A
font: Book: 16sp Medium (500); value: 24sp Medium (500); digits: 28sp Medium (500); confirmation: 14sp Medium (500).
note: The selected outlined field remains. The confirmation label uses Ok; suffix letters A/B/C remain functional identifiers.

title: Native song drawer
font: Book: 16sp Medium (500); value: 24sp Medium (500); digits: 28sp Medium (500); confirmation: 16sp Medium (500).
note: Native song controls preserve sentence case while keeping songbook codes and suffix letters.

title: Verse report
font: Action label: system sans, 14sp Medium (500); reference: 16sp Regular (400).
note: The form retains its casing. The colored submit action is below this viewport and is verified separately by the API 26/34 native-control regression checks. No report is submitted.

title: Reading-plan download catalog
font: Owned WebView catalog: tabs 14px Medium (500), body 16px Regular (400); actions retain the page sizing.
note: The scoped catalog adapter disables uppercase CSS and normalizes uppercase action/tab labels, preserving technical terms such as ID and JSON. No server deployment is required.

title: Songbook download catalog
font: Owned WebView catalog: tabs 14px Medium (500), body/name 16px Regular (400), descriptions 14px Regular (400).
note: The same scoped sentence-case rule applies to the songbook catalog; source songbook names are retained.
